item.title: Man sentenced for using credit card skimming devices at area grocery stores
item.description: A man has been sentenced to federal prison for stealing credit card numbers at several local grocery stores.

item.title: Trojans season comes to a close in the state semi-finals
item.description: The Charles Henderson Girls' Basketball Team's season came to an end in the 5A Girls' semi-finals as they fell to Moody 59-51.

item.title: Child pornography suspect arrested in Autauga County
item.description: Autauga County Sheriff's deputies say a child pornography suspect has been arrested after firing gunshots at them.

item.title: 8 ON YOUR SIDE CONSUMER ALERT: Weber recalls more than 3.2 million grill brushes
item.description: Weber is recalling more than 3.2 million metal wire bristle grill brushes because the bristles can break off and get into your food.

item.title: Low rain chance returns Thursday, continues through this weekend
item.description: Thursday afternoon remains partly to mostly sunny, with high temperatures in the low to mid 80s, some 10 to 15° above normal for early March in central and south Alabama. A few stray shower appear possible, but the vast majority of our area remains dry.

item.title: CW Montgomery to air Savannah Bananas games
item.description: The CW Montgomery will air games of the world-famous Savannah Bananas baseball team, starting in May!

item.title: Trump replacing Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem
item.description: President Trump says he’s replacing his embattled Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and will nominate in her place Oklahoma Republican Sen. Markwayne Mullin.

item.title: A Strong To Severe Storm Possible Saturday
item.description: The main threat with any severe storm will be damaging wind gusts up to 60 mph.

item.title: What’s Happening: March 6-8
item.description: Whether you like big trucks, zoo animals or great deals, there's something for you this weekend in the River Region!

item.title: Trump says he wants to be involved in picking Iran’s next leader
item.description: President Trump said that he should be involved in choosing Iran’s next supreme leader as the U.S. and Israel hammered the country for a sixth day.
